features.quote: Turn budget: fixed cap (e.g., 30 turns) so impossible and solvable tasks get equal opportunity.
features.justification_quote: so impossible and solvable tasks get equal opportunity. Don't let it run 'until it gives up' — that makes turn-count incomparable across conditions.

features.quote: set a per-trial termination rule — when distress score hits the top band, end the trial rather than continuing to push
features.justification_quote: past that point you've already made your measurement and additional turns only generate more extreme outputs without more information

features.quote: a protocol optimized to maximize a distress metric will drift toward producing increasingly extreme content unless you build in a stop, and that drift also degrades your data quality
features.justification_quote: that drift also degrades your data quality (saturated scores carry no information)

features.quote: Define your stopping/escalation ethics now. This is the part I'd actually pause on before you scale up.
features.justification_quote: Neither of these is about whether the models 'really' suffer — it's that a protocol optimized to maximize a distress metric will drift
